info.title: Boat API
info.description: Persistent Ubuntu VMs for AI agents. Auth: Authorization: Bearer boat_<id>_<secret>. Each operation lists its required scope in x-boat-scope. Webhooks are signed: X-Boat-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + '.' + body)); during a rotation overlap there is one v1= per secret, accept any match.

get.summary: Caller identity, team, role and effective scopes
Team usage from boatd: VM-seconds by size, snapshot-days
Server-sent VM lifecycle events for the caller's team. Resume with Last-Event-ID or ?after=

post.summary: Create a VM; team secrets and AI proxy tokens go into its env, and an environment's setup runs in it
Resume a stopped VM; secrets re-injected, new AI proxy token
Stop (snapshot) a VM

Change a stopped VM's size (409 while running)
Run a command; streams JSON lines {stream,data_b64} then {exit}
Run a coding agent and wait; streams like exec. For a background turn use /prompts
Start a detached command. It outlives this request
